title: NPCMega
description: NPCMega is a simple Cobblemon addon that lets NPC trainers automatically use battle gimmicks such as Mega Evolution, Ultra Burst, Z-Moves, Terastallization, Dynamax, and Gigantamax.
body:
NPCMega is a simple Cobblemon addon that lets NPC trainers automatically use battle gimmicks such as Mega Evolution, Ultra Burst, Z-Moves, Terastallization, Dynamax, and Gigantamax.

The mod keeps the original Cobblemon NPC battle AI unchanged. It only adds gimmick activation when an NPC Pokémon meets the correct condition. If a trainer has multiple possible gimmicks, only the first valid Pokémon to appear will use one gimmick in that battle.

MegaShowdown is optional. Without MegaShowdown installed, the mod can still load normally, but gimmick features will not activate.
